title: SwarmPack
description: Root object of the off-chain Swarm Pack. charterHash = SHA-256 over the JCS (RFC 8785) canonical form of this object; objectiveHash = SHA-256 over the canonical form of the objective member; commitmentHash = SHA-256 over the canonical form of the commitment member (zero on-chain when the pack has none); a phase's descriptorHash SHOULD be the digest of the matching mode.phases member. No digest is stored inside the member it covers. The pack carries everything a candidate's decision to join depends on and everything an allocation rule or indexer needs that the registry does not execute: the charter text, the objective descriptor, the economic commitment, the collaboration structure per phase, the roles, the resource manifest, the decision-point descriptions and the version chain. It never overrides the on-chain SwarmSpec; where the two disagree, the spec is what runs.

version.description: Charter version; equals the registry's charterVersion after the amendment that published it

specHash.description: The on-chain SwarmSpec this pack describes

origin.description: Informative mirror of the on-chain Origin record: how the swarm came to exist

kind.description: sai.origin.initiator | joint | task | trigger | decision | succession, or an extension; keccak256 of this string is the on-chain kind

ref.description: The on-chain reference the kind gives meaning to

path.description: Primary human-readable charter document inside the pack (Markdown)

digest.description: SHA-256 of the charter document's bytes

kind.description: What the on-chain acceptanceAuthority is: a verifier contract, a designated judge, a collective-decision adapter, an obligation adapter reading a bound external duty such as a task tender

policyId.description: collective: the decision policy the adapter files under

amendmentRule.description: Who may amend the objective and what members may do when it changes; MUST be consistent with the AMEND authority and amendmentExitWindow

commitment.description: The members' economic commitment: what they are owed and what they are exposed to. Committed on-chain as commitmentHash; any change of this member is a material amendment by construction (the registry compares the hash, never reads the text). Members beyond the five below are allowed and are covered by the hash.

phase.description: Name of the phase the rule applies to (mode.phases[].name)

allocation.description: How outcome value maps to members, per phase; what the payoff posture declares in words

costs.description: Costs members bear: metered resources, bonds, fees

liabilities.description: What members may be held to: delivery obligations, penalties, indemnities

externalActions.description: Actions taken in the members' name through the swarm account or otherwise

namedProfile.description: Informative label: cooperation, competition, co-opetition, tender, staged-elimination, debate, ensemble, pipeline, hierarchical, standing-committee, internal-market

payoff.description: Dotted name of the registered payoff term; keccak256 of this string is the on-chain term. Base terms: sai.payoff.shared, sai.payoff.exclusive, sai.payoff.mixed

topology.description: Dotted name of the registered topology term. Base terms: sai.topology.redundant, partitioned, sequential, hierarchical, iterative, free

coordination.description: Dotted name of the registered coordination term. Base terms: sai.coordination.leader, collective, market, automated, none

selection.description: SELECT phases: how the ADVANCE authority chooses who carries over

inputWindow.description: Informative mirror of the spec's inputWindow in seconds; 0 = unbounded

contributions.description: Informative: what a contribution record means in this phase and how its hash is formed

requires.description: Human-readable predicates, e.g. 'trust assertion level >= 3 under scheme X from issuers A, B', 'agent identity ACTIVE', 'registered agent with reputation >= r'

kind.description: sai.resource.<name>: skill, dataset, tool, code, model, document, oracle, fund, or an extension kind; keccak256 of this string is the on-chain kind

anchor.description: On-chain anchor (a token-bound skill, a registered dataset, a fund contract); absent for a purely off-chain resource

digest.description: Commitment to the resource content under digestKind; the on-chain record compares, never computes

digestKind.description: How digest was computed: sha-256, keccak256, or a name an adapter defines for what its anchored contracts report; keccak256 of this string is the on-chain digestKind

uri.description: Transport hint for the content; never a verification source

roleId.description: Role whose members may use the resource; absent = every member

provider.description: Who provides or manages the resource; may differ from the attaching authority and from the anchor's controller

terms.description: Usage terms, e.g. the licensing or metering the anchored skill enforces and who pays

decisionPoints.description: Informative description of each authority, keyed by decision point name (ACTIVATE ... REPRESENT): who holds it and, for collective decisions, which policy the adapter files under

prev.description: charterHash of the previous version as sha256:<hex>; null at version 1
